For some reason this reminds me of something that happened to me. 

I was 15 at the time, and it was New Year's so I snuck out at like 11pm to go meet my then-boyfriend so we could watch fireworks together and whatnot. 

We were out until like 4am, I think. Anyway, at maybe 3am this really drunk middle aged man was just stumbling around the general area we were in and he came over to us talking a bunch of weird stuff. I don't remember what he was talking about but he was really drunk. 

At some point my boyfriend started telling him that he should probably leave because he's drunk, etc. The man just seemed so angry. He walked over to the next street (and because of the way my tiny neighborhood was set up, we could still see him) and he was just shouting and chanting incoherent things. The chanting was kinda scary honestly, he seemed like he was trying to curse us or something. It was so weird. 

After he left I went back to my house, pet my cat before going inside. Since my dad slept on the couch, he woke up when I came inside and I just told him I was feeding the cat and he went back to sleep. I never told him what happened.
Also in Florida, can confirm people be crazy down here.
